arm_summary.rule: closure (imposed ISO area law as pressure source)
negative control with zero scatter: p = 1.9 MPa exactly, no area dependence -- deterministic zero check of the estimator
declared sensitivity: rate-dependent crushing with n equal to |declared reference exponent| (not a calibration)

implied_rate_exponent.note: n_implied = ex_target / (beta_h + beta_V - 1); compare with the cited brittle-crushing window before drawing any conclusion

admissible_beta_window.note: the target exponent is reproducible by a rate mechanism only if the ensemble's beta_h + beta_V falls inside this window

criteria.criterion: deterministic zero check: with a constant contact pressure (cv = 0) the estimator must return exactly zero
treatment exponent separates from the negative-control floor by >= 3 combined sigma at every concentration (primary estimator = cells of fixed thickness x closing speed, (16, 16))
treatment exponent recovered by the conditioned estimator is within 15 % of the declared reference -0.28

detail.caveat: the estimator is attenuated towards zero at finite conditioning; the bias-free limit is -n (= -0.33), which is 17.9 % away from -0.28 -- see I3

criteria.criterion: bias-corrected statement: the recovered exponent equals the arm's own mechanism exponent -n (attenuation accounted for via the convergence sweep)

detail.reading: |ex| grows monotonically with the conditioning resolution while the control stays put: the limit is the mechanism exponent, not -0.28

criteria.criterion: population (unconditioned) exponent of the treatment sits inside the negative-control floor -- the W24 FAIL mode

detail.note: CONFIRMED reproduces the W24 outcome and explains it by ex_pop = n (beta_h + beta_V - 1)

criteria.criterion: control: when the mechanism really is an area law (closure arm) the same conditioned estimator returns that law's exponent, so the conditioning does not destroy a genuine area dependence
the declared reference exponent -0.28 is reproducible by an indentation-rate mechanism on this population only if the implied rate exponent falls inside the declared brittle-crushing window
